been with this surgery for over 20 years.  It used to be highly regarded in Maghull / Lydiate but the service to its community has dramatically declined.

Receptionists / Admin or ‘Care Navigators’ as they like to be called do not navigate you anywhere with care, this is a myth.

-  You’ll hardly ever get to see a doctor, they seem to triage most of their patients to Associate Physicians.  Whilst some of the ‘Physicians’ are good, they are not doctors so if you have any persistent / complex conditions, you may be passed about a bit.

-  If you ever need to submit a PMA request, good luck as certain doctors will just have such requests sitting in their respective trays and do nothing.  I’ve been waiting months and chasing almost every other day.

The ‘Care Navigators’ either don’t acknowledge you or just say “we are not allowed to contact or chase doctors”.  Clearly this is a lie, they have no means to contact doctors directly lol!

-  They will also change your doctor, one you’ve had for years without informing you.

-  Just to confuse you when making appointments, they often change the platform used to make appointments.  Example, eConsult, Blinx etc…. These are not intuitive platforms to use, particularly Blinx.  Wouldn’t you think you could just book appointments using the NHS App by now!

- Contact by phone can be challenging.  You can be number ‘one’ in the queue but 45 minutes later you can still be waiting.  If you call in person to the surgery whilst still on the phone, you’ll just see people standing around chatting.  Then when you complain, they just say there’s an issue with the lines.

-  Specialist letters where care is handed back to your GP to be managed are never acknowledged / uploaded to medical records so you end up chasing so that any life saving medication is available / ordered in time.

- Repeat prescriptions are often signalled as rejected when you check your NHS App but when you chase this up, they say “Oh, must be a mistake”.  This happens far too often…

-  Always get second opinions too if you are not happy with something.  Go private (if you have the means).  I had a very near life impacting condition that was not picked up.

I could go on and on with this surgery and I bet there’s lots of other surgery’s out there that are similar.

I stay with them because it’s better the devil you know, than the one you
